title: Ahoy, DECmate II the little PDP-8 that could
summary: This is a nostalgic blog article about the DECmate II, a vintage computer from the early 1980s that was based on the PDP-8 architecture. The author explores the history and capabilities of this small but resilient machine, celebrating its place in computing history.
problem_solved: Documents and preserves knowledge about vintage computing hardware from the early 1980s era.
why_valuable: Provides historical context and technical appreciation for classic computing systems that shaped the early personal computer era.
